name: Memento
source:
Lillian, a college student who is about to graduate, waits for her boyfriend, Aaron, at the park. He has a special day planned for her that she will remember until death do us part.

[From [url=https://jjbeats99.itch.io/memento-omori]Itch.io[/url]]
